subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat ship only Copy and Select Copy first, or should the initial action sheet also include Share and Reply?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the missing behavior, but Share and Reply add product scope beyond a narrow copy/select fix and previous implementation attempts have not established maintainer acceptance for the full four-action menu.

options.title: Approve copy/select first
options.body: Land Copy and Select Copy across both Android chat surfaces, and defer Share and Reply unless maintainers sponsor that broader parity work separately.

options.title: Approve full action sheet
options.body: Include Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply now, accepting the broader composer and Android share-sheet scope in one feature.

options.title: Keep blocked for sponsorship
options.body: Leave the issue open without new repair work until a maintainer explicitly sponsors the Android chat parity direction.

recommendation.title: Approve copy/select first
recommendation.body: Land Copy and Select Copy across both Android chat surfaces, and defer Share and Reply unless maintainers sponsor that broader parity work separately.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus has the strongest recent history across Android chat and ChatMarkdown behavior in the affected files.
